title: Grateful Dead Live at Dance Hall on 1967-09-04

ai_review.summary: Rustic soundboard snippet captures a rare early Caution > Feedback jam and Mickey Hart’s first sit‑in, offering an acid‑trip vibe despite audible tape splice.
ai_review.review: The partial recording delivers decent, slightly rustic soundboard quality—listeners hear a tape splice at the start but the mix remains listenable. Musically it highlights an extended Caution → Feedback jam that many describe as a psychedelic “acid freakout” and marks Mickey Hart’s inaugural appearance with the band, making it a historically interesting excerpt.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the unique early jam and historic moment, while noting modest recording fidelity; overall positive musical value outweighs technical quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape splice audible at the beginning; sound is rustic but clear enough for listening. No major drop‑outs, though overall fidelity is modest.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a fragment of the show is available; the excerpt showcases an early psychedelic jam that feels like an “acid freakout” and highlights Mickey Hart’s first sit‑in toward the end.

band_member_comments.Jerry: After Mickey sat in, Jerry turned, hugged him and said "THIS is the Grateful Dead".
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil recalls the Aliligator/Caution/Feedback sequence from this gig.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart’s first appearance on drums toward the end of the set.
